products.name: FlatRate Builder: Billable-Hour Pricebook Calculator
products.unique_concept: Pricing tool that derives loaded labor rate and overhead per BILLABLE hour (not paid hour), marks parts up in tiers and outputs good/better/best flat-rate prices with a margin check; a pricebook builder without per-user software fees.
products.pain_points: Pricing by feel; overhead forgotten; per-user software fees
products.pitch_points: Price every job from your real costs; consistent pricebook; no subscription
features: Cost inputs (wages, burden, vehicle, insurance, tools, annual billable hours)
Job template library (labor hours + parts) with good/better/best options
Flat price = total cost/(1 - target margin); margin and effective $/hr shown
Pricebook export (CSV) and print sheet, localStorage
products.build_spec: Single-file HTML. loaded_rate = annual_cost/billable_hours; overhead_per_hr = overhead/billable_hours; job_cost = hours x (loaded_rate+overhead_per_hr) + parts x (1+markup); price = job_cost/(1-margin). Defaults shown as editable examples sourced H3; no claim of industry standard. Unit tests (e.g. $120,000/1,200 = $100/hr) + phone width.

novelty_check.vs_memory: checked against memory/products.json (57 entries) and daily 2026-11-24/25/26 products; no duplicate

products.score_note: self-scored from evidence cards; confidence Med/Low where noted

products.name: Estimate Chaser: Unsold Estimate Follow-Up Tracker
products.unique_concept: Tracks every open estimate with value, age and next follow-up date, ranks the money at risk and supplies short follow-up messages; built for estimates that die in a text thread.
products.pitch_points: See open-estimate value; follow up on schedule; scripts ready
features: Estimate list (customer, job, amount, date sent, status)
Win/loss log with reason, win rate by month
products.build_spec: Single-file HTML. open_value = sum(amount where status=open); next_follow_up = sent + cadence step; win_rate = won/(won+lost). No claim that follow-up closes X% (README cites vendor claims as unverified). Unit tests + phone width.

novelty_check.vs_memory: checked against memory/products.json (57 entries) and daily 2026-11-24/25/26 products; no duplicate

products.score_note: Evidence is Low-Med (one trade study + vendor claims)

products.name: Chair Math: Commission vs Booth Rent Calculator
products.unique_concept: Break-even calculator for stylists and owners comparing commission, booth rent and hybrid deals from the person's own numbers, with a printable side-by-side.

products.name: New-Client Fee Check: Marketplace Fee Calculator
products.unique_concept: Calculator that shows whether marketplace new-client fees (e.g. 20-30% first-visit fees) beat a subscription-only platform, using the stylist's own lifetime-value and rebooking inputs.
products.pain_points: Hard to compare new-client fees vs subscriptions

features: Platform presets with editable fee % / minimum / monthly price (labelled 'check current terms')
Inputs: avg ticket, visits per client per year, rebook rate

products.build_spec: Single-file HTML. first_visit_fee = max(min_fee, fee% x ticket); client_value = ticket x expected_visits; net = client_value - first_visit_fee. Presets from S2 flagged as 'as reported by comparison sites, may be outdated'. Unit tests.
